title: Grill — Issue #298: Chrome browser prompt + bundled-tmux terminal

scope.title: Which halves of issue #298 does this change fix?

matcher-breadth.title: How broad should the new unnumbered-menu matcher be?

chrome-policy.title: Should Agetor ever answer the Chrome browser-tools prompt for the user?
chrome-policy.display: Always show the card; never auto-answer

terminfo-source.title: Where should the bundled tmux get its terminfo database?

terminfo-scope.title: Which tmux surfaces should get the terminfo override?

failure-feedback.title: How much failure feedback should Open in Terminal give?
failure-feedback.display: Await + keep the window open on failure

card-presentation.title: How should the choice card present an unnumbered menu?
card-presentation.display: Keep the numbered-button convention; Hide the synthetic keys for unnumbered menus

dismiss.title: Should the choice card gain a Dismiss (Esc) action?

acceptance.title: What counts as done for this change?
acceptance.display: Units + typecheck + a manual Terminal smoke

docs.title: Update the docs that describe this behavior
docs.value: Yes — update `docs/architecture/harness-claude-code.md` (matcher chain + attach env), the `docs/plans/unknown-claude-prompts-fallback.md` addendum, and the manual QA row `docs/qa/master-token-agent-read-qa.md:53-54`.

commit.title: Local commit shape
commit.value: One local commit, not pushed, message `fix: answer the unnumbered Claude Chrome prompt and repair bundled-tmux attach (Fixes #298)`.

unparsable-stays.title: Keep the unparsable card as the final fallback
unparsable-stays.value: Yes — genuinely unknown prompts still get the `unparsable` card with its Open in Terminal action.

cross-agent.title: No cross-agent Chrome arbitration
cross-agent.value: Yes — this change only makes the Claude startup prompt answerable; it does not coordinate Chrome between Codex, Claude Desktop, and Agetor.
